value.behaviour: Unit-test normalizeTextRanges, applyTextRangeStyle, getUniformTextRangeStyle, shiftTextRanges, shiftTextRangesAtOffset, splitTextIntoStyledSegments, getLineTextRuns, and projectTextRangesOntoLines.
rules: 1. Import normalizeTextRanges, applyTextRangeStyle, getUniformTextRangeStyle, shiftTextRanges, shiftTextRangesAtOffset, splitTextIntoStyledSegments, getLineTextRuns, and projectTextRangesOntoLines from ../src/textStyles.

2. Test normalization of out-of-bounds, negative, reversed, non-finite, empty, transparent, baseStrokeColor-matching, overlapping, and adjacent identical ranges, plus UTF-16 astral emoji surrogate pair offsets.
3. Test applyTextRangeStyle independent colour and highlight application, partial overlap splitting, clearing via "transparent", null, or baseStrokeColor, and getUniformTextRangeStyle.

4. Test shiftTextRanges and shiftTextRangesAtOffset for insertions before, strictly inside, at range.start, at range.end (extending range.end), and after ranges, as well as deletions and replacements.

5. Test getLineTextRuns and projectTextRangesOntoLines for pure-LTR lines (!hasRTLChars) and RTL/mixed-bidi lines (hasRTLChars, including LTR-first lines containing Arabic script and Arabic-Indic digits) across left, center, and right alignments.

tests.name: normalizes, clamps, merges adjacent, and resolves overlapping ranges
tests.given: Unsorted, out-of-bounds, empty, transparent, baseStrokeColor-matching, and overlapping TextRangeStyle entries
tests.expect: Returns sorted non-overlapping merged ranges or undefined when all ranges are cleared

tests.name: applies and clears colour and highlight independently across overlapping spans
tests.given: An existing coloured range [0, 10] and a highlight applied to [3, 7] followed by clearing colour on [2, 5]
tests.expect: Preserves highlight on [3, 7] while removing colour on [2, 5] and merging adjacent identical spans

tests.name: shifts ranges across insertions, deletions, replacements, and range-end boundary typing
tests.given: A styled range [2, 7] in originalText with insertions at 0, 2, 4, 7, and 9, plus deletions and replacements
tests.expect: Typing at offset 7 extends the range end to 7 + k while typing at offset 2 shifts both start and end by +k

tests.name: preserves UTF-16 code-unit offsets around astral-plane emoji surrogate pairs
tests.given: Text containing 😀 (2 UTF-16 code units) before and inside styled ranges
tests.expect: Range offsets and shifted spans align with string.slice UTF-16 indices without splitting surrogate pairs

tests.name: computes accurate x and width for pure-LTR, pure-RTL, and LTR-first mixed-bidi lines
tests.given: Visual lines with !hasRTLChars(line.text), pure Arabic RTL text, and LTR-first mixed text "Price: ١٢٠ درهم" across left, center, and right alignments
tests.expect: Pure-LTR lines use left-prefix widths and hasRTLChars lines order bidi runs visually with non-zero widths summing to lineWidth
